name: SPT Leaderboard
teaser: The Ultimate Leaderboard for SPT. Connect and explore along other SPT players worldwide.
description:
Introduction
Warning: This mod connects to an external service owned by the author of this mod to send certain SPT Profile/Request Data from your SPT game (more information on what data the mod sends is in FAQ tab), this service is not maintained by or associated with the SPT Project.

SPT Leaderboard – Rank Globally in SPTarkov!

Highly suggested to pair with Stattrack by AcidPhantasm!

Please READ “Brief Look and Installation” tab or: Join our Discord Server

Key Features:

  • Global Rankings and Statistics – Record many stats like K/D (both PMC and SCAV), survival rate, total kills (PMCs, SCAVs, Bosses), damage dealt, and longest shot distance along with total raids completed, win streaks (current and longest), average engagement distance, and raid history with detailed breakdowns. There’s much more to uncover, but it’s all up to you to find about more.
  • SPTLB Network & Economy – Earn Leaderboard Coins (LC) by playing the game, completing achievements, explore Tarkov Market and spend LC on Tarkov quest keys, barter items or gear, withdraw your bought items right into your game, open cases, report players, and edit your profile. All in one place.
  • Casual Mode and Ranked – Feeling competitive? Or just want access to all features? We’re prepared for both scenarios. Compete with others by SPTLB house rules (SPT Vanilla+) in Ranked mode or get access to all* features with Casual Mode** without restrictions. (*Trading will not be accessible in Casual Mode. **Enable Casual Mode in your F12 BepInEx settings.)
  • BattlePass – Get your unique rewards, progress by playing, unlock Premium and have freedom of choice what to do with the rewards - sell them, withdraw into your SPT game or share some with your friend.
  • Teams – Have your own team tag on the leaderboard and team up with others.
  • Live Data Flow – Your statistics and profile update instantly* after every raid with no manual input required and minimal latency. Just install the mod and watch yourself progress. (*There might be delays due CloudFlare website caching)
  • Weapon Meta & Global Insights – Discover the live weapon stats used by all players along the attachment pick rates and loadouts. Get a peek at global data, most-played maps, and community distributions SPT Leaderboard has ever recorded.
  • Permanent Raid History – Watch your or others Raid History with ease on anyones’, or your profile. Including extra breakdowns.
  • Deep Profile Customization and Awards – Change your profile picture, display last raid statistics, change your About Me or set a custom name, share PMC/SCAV profiles, change your profile theme, level up Leaderboard Level, BattlePass and your Weapon Mastery to unlock even more rewards. Many possibilities are open, just for you!
  • Season End & Reward System – Leaderboard resets with major SPT/mod updates, but past progress remains archived forever you can easily access with a dropdown.
  • Self-Hosting Freedom – It’s your choice to enter a Global Leaderboard, or host it solely for your friends* and other purposes! (*No backend is provided, you’d have to implement an API yourself.)
  • Your Data is truly Yours – Your Unique Secret Token ensures your data is linked to your profile, including stats, and your SPTLB Network profile.

By installing and using this mod, you agree to the Terms of Service (TOS) and License Agreement (LA) of this project.

Cheating/Spoofing will get you temporarily or permanently banned from the SPT Leaderboard. Permanent bans are non-discussable and always final.

Leaderboard Website - Link
SPTLB Discord Server - Link
Post your Issues Here - Link

Installation and Brief Look

SPT Leaderboard - Installation

This mod installation is can differ depending on your SPT Setup. Here’s a simple guide:

Non-Fika users (default SPT installation) - Drag and drop/replace the contents of the 7z archive.

Fika users who host the server - SPT Leaderboard Server mod must be installed. Client Mod still goes into your game folder where you launch your game and is not required to be installed on headless client if you use that.

Users who use ModSync - This would sync your secret tokens across the clients. We do not support this setup in any way and this may lead to unexpected errors in SPTLB Network including data loss.

Secret Token - what does it do, how to login into SPTLB Network and what you might wanna know

Secret Token - A simple .token file your client mod generates is your key to the Leaderboard. Your secret token is used in many places, but in different shapes - from getting into the leaderboard to creating a profile for you. First of all, and please - backup your secret token somewhere else. There’s many cases when people were reinstalling the mod on the update, only to find out their token doesn’t match anymore.

Your secret token is your password to everything. Once you pass all the checks for legitimacy of the profile and raid data, you’ll appear on Leaderboard and be automatically registered in database. All your profiles you make in the future will have same password (that secret token) and different Profile ID. After making sure Leaderboard registered your profile, you can safely login using that Profile ID and your Secret Token. There’s no register button for this - everything is done on the go, requiring you only to find your secret token inside /BepInEx/plugins/SPTLeaderboard/secret.token and open it with any text editor.

TLDR: The profile IDs you own only matter for item withdrawals when you login. Your token and market token are always the same, meaning you can login into SPTLB Network using any of your registered Profile IDs and same Secret Token.

Market Token - What’s the difference between Secret Token and what is it used for?

Market Token is quite different from secret token - it still belongs to your Secret Token and is also unique. It is used to privately store your SPTLB Network data, like your inventory, notifications, Trust Factor, Achievements, Settings, Friends and more. It’s also used for any item or LC transactions along BattlePass.

How to find it?

Login into SPTLB Network and click on your Profile Picture at top left - then Settings. Scroll down and you’ll see this:

What it is useful for? Not much useful for a casual user, but might be useful for people who might be interested in working with SPTLB API.

Casual Mode - how to use it and what to be aware of

Casual Mode can be found in your BepInEx settings of SPT Leaderboard mod, which upon enabling and finishing a raid puts you in some kind of a ghost state on the leaderboard - you’re free of using any mods you have installed or any other restrictions, but you won’t be ranked with other non-casual players anymore. Almost every other feature will be available for you, except LC and Item Transfers. This is useful for people who just want to get a glimpse at features SPT Leaderboard provides, or they don’t want to bother with their mods to get in.

Be aware - once you enabled this feature, you can no longer turn the profile to non-casual anymore.

SPT Leaderboard - Config System

Client Mod

All settings in a client mod are already well described. Find SPT-Leaderboard tab in BepInEx menu and hover over the settings.

NOTE: Shaded/Gradient themes don’t support backgrounds.

BattlePass Features

All of the Leaderboard BattlePass features are now in SPTLB Network in your profile editor!

Mod Support

This mod automatically detects and supports mods it can if they are installed on your SPT. Here’s a full list of what’s supported:

  • Project Fika - Full support, including multiple player instances simultaneously online and playing using Headless client.
  • WTT - Welcome To Tarkov - Support for its custom achievements including but not limited to achievements page, player profiles, weapon icons and other metadata on modded weapons on both Meta, and player profile pages.
  • StatTrack - Full support. Includes custom tracking player loss of a weapon on the server, preventing from losing previous weapon stats. Will display all weapons on profile page, including player’s most used weapon, and record the statistics on Meta Page.
  • ODT’s Item Info - Only clean weapon names from StatTrack are passed to user profile/meta page. This includes a robust solution from preventing showing of color tags, and other stylings the mod utilizes inside the weapon names.
  • [SAIN] Twitch Players - Players who use this mod will get their name styled in Red color.
  • Pause - Properly displays raid time if player was in the pause. Mainly this is done for Casual Players.
Message For Modders

If you’d like to help this project build the safe environment around its player base and wanna contribute, here’s what you can do. This is by all means is volunteer!

  • Spotted something a casual user haven’t? We’d gladly listen to you at our Discord Server, or GitHub!
  • Wanna add your modded items, cases, or whatever else to SPTLB Network Tarkov Market? You can! Send us a request within our GitHub, or Discord Server so we could discuss it further.
  • Wanna collaborate for a special event? You can, too!
FAQ

Q: I didn’t read the mod page, lost my secret token and reinstalled my SPT 3 times, how can I get my secret token back?
A: The only thing you can now do is start anew with new secret token. SPTLB Team does not offer secret token recovery.

Q: I have done everything and can’t access, or send any raid data. Nothing appears in my SPT game, or website doesn’t load.
A: Try using a different website to see leaderboard - https://sptlb-ru.katrinfoxvr.com. If you don’t send any raid data being sent after raid end, try setting host to that specific address in your F12 BepInEx settings (from https://sptlb.katrinfoxvr.com to https://sptlb-ru.katrinfoxvr.com).

Q: What happens when season ends? Do I completely reinstall the mod? Do everything reset?
A: When season ends, a new mod version will be posted online. Install instructions are always present in the version description/patch notes. Most of the times it’s just a simple drag and drop/replace. As for the season end, here’s what happens:

  • Data that gets WIPED:
    • Your Leaderboard LEVEL (Not the BattlePass!)
    • Your main Leaderboard statistics, KDR, SR, and other statistics along Skill Score
    • Your dynamic profile picture
    • Your raid history, if your raid history is too small or is older than 4 months since last time it’s been used
  • Data that NEVER gets WIPED:
    • Your comments on the profile
    • Your market account that is synced with your secret token
    • Your SPTLB Network inventory, notifications, global stats
    • Your BattlePass, its level and overall progress until new BattlePass is announced
    • Your Leaderboard Profile customization settings
    • Global weapon, item, achievement data that’s been collected

Q: I can’t login to SPTLB Network!
A: You have to complete at least one raid with SPT Leaderboard mod so system can register you. Then, you have use your token and profile ID for logging in. You have to MAKE SURE you’re on the Leaderboard, received in-game success extraction notification or anything else that proves you’re in.

Q: Can I use this mod offline?
A: No, for leaderboard features to work it requires internet connection

Q: What’s the entry requirements for the leaderboard? I don’t wanna get banned!
A: SPT Leaderboard offers a fair place for many players while remaining consistent:

  • No high PMC health, hydration or energy - We allow only Realism Players and health boost on elite health perk
  • No mods considered as cheating tools to gain unfair advantage in statistics - Any sort of radar, revival mods, and mods that give you a very unfair advantage such as overpowered ammunition. Read LA/TOS for more clarity. Or you can view globally banned mods on the main website page of SPT Leaderboard

Q: I get “insert error” error in my SPT Console!
A: The only errors you can get in SPT Console are from SPT Leaderboard Server mod. It does make a connection to our service, and sometimes, due your Firewall settings, VPNs, or ISP can fail to get a response. Nothing to be afraid of - you can safely ignore the error.

Q: Why this mod tells me to update it?
A: This is a live service mod. Project instantly cuts off its old versions on release to prevent bad data being sent to the server. This insures consistency and stability of the project so the player can instantly reach new content on the page and in-game. Sometimes an exception is made, whenever the release is a hotfix, or just a small update that doesn’t require updating right away.

Q: Will this affect my SPT gameplay/performance?
A: Barely. Almost all of the data being processed and sent happens before/after raid. You only send heartbeats during raid to the server and count hits.

Q: How often are my stats updated on the leaderboard?
A: Instantly after end of the raid.

Q: How do I register on the leaderboard? I can’t login!
A: Play one raid. If you didn’t encounter any pop ups in game about your status, and after the end of the raid you see yourself

Q: Does it work with multiple profiles (or Fika)?
A: Yes. The mod has integrated Fika combability, and also supports multiple profiles per Token. However any usage of sync mods such as ModSync, are not supported in any way, and all issues you run into including permanent data loss, is on you or the group of the accounts.

Q: But everyone can just mod the hell out of their stats?
A: Leaderboard, Server and Website comes with various protections, player reports, calibration and own mechanics along Moderation Team. Project explicitly follows and enforces its ToS and LA across all players. SPT Leaderboard also offers “Start from Zero” (since Season 3) and Casual Mode for those, who don’t want to look out for their installed mods and modified game.

Q: What data this mod sends to leaderboard?
A: Raid metrics and SPT profile data. Note that SPT Leaderboard will never collect personal information, everything you see on the leaderboard website is recorded from SPT client. Here’s a full list:
- Your secret token generated by the mod. Never delete it, share with someone you don’t know or change. Always make and keep a backup of it - you will not be able to get back in leaderboard under your own profile you played on before until new season starts. SPTLB Team is not responsible for your token loss.
- Your SPT Profile data and Raid Data
- Its own signature
- Heartbeats to the server with only state and id of a player with timestamp (i.e online, in stash, in raid)
- Request to check for inbox on the server. This is done for profile rewards, withdrawals off the account, or messages regarding profile standing.
For any further questions about your data and what is being sent, visit source code of the client/server mod.

Note: None of personal information gets sent to the server.

LA/TOS

SPT Leaderboard - Legal Agreement / Terms of Service (LA/TOS)

1. Code of Conduct & Fair Play

  • 1.1. Cheating and Exploitation: Any form of cheating, exploiting, or deception is strictly forbidden. This includes manipulating crucial game data (e.g., PMC/SCAV levels, quests, health, hydration, energy) and specific modifications, allowing “double armoring” (wearing armor on top of other armor). The mere presence of disallowed modifications for Ranked players may be deemed a violation at the SPT Leaderboard Team’s discretion.
  • 1.2. Allowed Mods: Only cosmetic, weapon, AI, and quality-of-life (QoL) mods are permitted. Gameplay-altering mods that provide an unfair advantage are strictly forbidden. Examples of prohibited mods include, but are not limited to: god mode, unlimited ammo, faster reloads, extra loot, radars, post-death revival, debug mods, environment mods, and less restrictive armor/headwear options. This applies only to Ranked players.
  • 1.3. Data Integrity: All submitted statistics must come from genuine gameplay. Submitting falsified or edited data is a direct violation and will result in a permanent ban.
  • 1.4. Content Guidelines (Usernames, PFPs, and “About Me”): All user-generated content must be appropriate for a general audience. Content that is offensive, discriminatory, hateful, sexually explicit (NSFW), or politically charged is strictly prohibited. This includes material related to racism, sexual racism, religious intolerance, political extremism, hate speech, harassment, and any form of political discourse or propaganda. Violations will result in removal from the leaderboard, a permanent restriction from profile changes, or a permanent ban.

2. Accounts & Participation

  • 2.1. Account Responsibility: You are solely responsible for all activity under your profile and secret token. Any submission or action made with your token is treated as an action taken by you. Do not share your token, 2FA password or any account details.
  • 2.2. Multi-Account Policy: Players may link multiple accounts under the same token/identifier. However, if any of them violate the rules, all linked accounts will be held responsible. Penalties (including restrictions, or bans) will be applied to the entire group of accounts.
  • 2.3. Account Purpose: Accounts are for genuine player use only. Test accounts, developer accounts, and any accounts not used for legitimate gameplay are prohibited. Violations will result in a profile ban and removal from the leaderboard for the offending account and potentially all linked accounts.
  • 2.4. Casual Mode Exception: While you may use gameplay-altering mods in Casual Mode, exploiting or harming the leaderboard remains prohibited. Casual Mode statistics are not eligible for the main leaderboard rankings.

3. Data Collection, Usage & Privacy

  • 3.1. Client-Side Data Collection (Mod): By installing the client-side mod, you agree that it will collect and transmit gameplay data exclusively during active game sessions. This data includes, but is not limited to: raid statistics (location, coordinates, player states), inventory, gear, profile progression (skills, level, quests, achievements), StatTrack weapon statistics, and Fika Project configurations. The mod will also read and modify files within its installation folder to function. You can disable transmission at any time by uninstalling the mod or disconnecting from the service via F12 BepInEx menu.
  • 3.2. Public Display & Licensing: By submitting data, you grant SPT Leaderboard a non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual license to use, display, and store your statistics publicly on the leaderboard and associated platforms. This applies to all profile data sent to the server and become a non-removable part of the public leaderboard history, with no technical process for deletion.
  • 3.3. Data Privacy & Immutability: The submitted dataset is a non-personal, anonymous snapshot of a gameplay session in a modified environment and does not constitute Personally Identifiable Information (PII). It is not (and must not be) linked to real accounts, passwords, or emails. To maintain integrity, a hashed/obfuscated version of your IP address may be temporarily collected alongside your token for anti-cheat analysis. This hashed IP is stored for no longer than one hour and then automatically erased. Only IPs flagged for malicious activity (e.g., brute-force attacks) are retained for developer review. Raw, unhashed IPs are never logged.

4. Moderation, Enforcement & Penalties

  • 4.1. Profile Standing & Automated Flagging: Profiles flagged by automated systems for suspicious activity or abnormal statistics may be banned without the right to appeal. You are responsible for ensuring your profile remains compliant. Upon identification of such activity, the SPTLB Team may issue a temporary ban pending investigation. The affected user will have the opportunity to appeal and must provide comprehensive evidence of their profile’s legitimacy. Failure to do so will result in a permanent ban.
  • 4.2. Moderation Authority: The Administration and Moderation teams reserve the sole right to review, modify, or remove any entries without prior notice. All moderation decisions are based on the principle of fair play. Decisions are final unless an explicit appeal option is stated.
  • 4.3. Service Management: Developers reserve the right to modify season durations, reset times, or scoring rules as needed. Developers may also modify, suspend, or discontinue the leaderboard service, in whole or in part, temporarily or permanently, without notice and without liability.

5. General Provisions

  • 5.1. Acknowledgment of Rules:: The SPT Leaderboard and its related services are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis without any warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, timely, secure, or error-free.
  • 5.2. Policy Updates: These Terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the leaderboard following an update implies acceptance of the new terms.

6. Limitation of Liability & Disclaimer

  • 6.1. Service “As Is”: The SPT Leaderboard and its services are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis without any warranties. We do not guarantee uninterrupted, timely, secure, or error-free service.
  • 6.2. No Liability:“: To the fullest extent permitted by law, the SPT Leaderboard Team, its developers, and moderators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages (including data loss or server interruptions) arising from your use of the service.

versions.description:
Hi. New Update. Interactive Map, 2FA, BattlePass and Season 11.

Client

  • Added embedded Zone Editor (Debug only).
  • Added advanced zone/sub-zone tracking, including distance walked, medicine used, time spent in the zone and kills.
  • Now scans its own directory for password.token for 2FA purposes.
  • Added Fika Project pre-raid settings support.
  • Decreased intervals for sending in_raid heartbeat to the server.
  • Added game coordinates into heartbeat data, and death data (x,y,z).
  • Added states to the in_raid heartbeat, whether player is looting, or recently engaged in a fight.
  • Added more information about the killer.
  • Improved Client-to-API sync timings and data transfer
  • Fixed SPTLB version label disappearing at rare occasions when paired with Fika Project

Website

  • New BattlePass for all!
    • Updated BattlePass configs to support the new 100 level system.
    • Now includes 100 levels instead of 25.
    • Updated logic for advanced mechanic support.
    • Includes a new RNG mechanic of acquiring some rewards. Instead of getting a stated reward, said reward will be randomly chosen from a pool of items and given to the player.
    • Premium track will also include more of the loot pools.
    • Increased Premium Subscription to 21,000 LC.
    • Due to the reward changes, we’ve reduced premium subscription duration to 7 days period.
  • Interactive Map is added, with many possibilities
    • Displays player deaths
    • Displays heatmap, exfils, map labels and more
    • Draws SPTLB Zones on the map
    • Displays live players on the map with various states
  • Added 2FA which can be activated on your account right now! It will protect your raids, and token from anyone logging in!
    • 2FA can be set in SPTLB Network inside settings
    • Shows protection status, option to re-set the 2FA, and Download a password
    • Once you set 2FA, you can enable protection for your raids, which would require you to download your password and put it inside your SPT Leaderboard mod directory (client side)
    • Added an ability to recover your token on the login page, if it was protected by 2FA before
    • 2FA will always ask for password on login page
  • Online heartbeats will be ignored if player is in raid
  • API now saves death info, including the body part where you’ve been killed
  • Adjusted Trust Factor update timings, which should make it update much faster
  • Updated Community API for more edge cases
  • Fixed market capital displaying wrong information. Now it displays the global wealth of the entire playerbase
  • Fixed real friends not showing in friend list due API error
  • Improved friend list with same method for data lookup from leaderboard (ie online times or players entirely)
  • Data that is being used will no longer be static and always update, as long as that player (presumably, playing with the same secret token) in the season.
  • Comment manager would automatically detect it and always use fresh name, PMC side just like on main profile card, profile picture as well as putting two badges next to the name.
  • Verified profiles are now clickable, too, allowing viewing profile that commented right away.
  • Players who no longer appear on the leaderboard or season, would be treated as “Guests” (the data would be old, and never update) until they appear on the season. Verifying is fully automatic, and it should never fail
  • Fixed weapon card not displaying top players on hover
  • EFT Edition is now included inside account information
  • Overhauled user profile main card styles
  • Removed PFP size stylings for user profiles due
  • Player gear now uses batching for loading weapon icons
  • Added a Top 5 richest players when you hover over Market Capital in SPTLB Network
  • Reduced weekly drop required EXP to 100,000 EXP

And many many other improvements over entire codebase we surely forgot to include…

In this release

  • Removed redundant code
  • Removed FixPluginTypesSerialization
    • Unfortunately this plugin caused conflicts with some other mods so the decision was made to remove it

Introducing: (Re) Ongoing Event, Player Equipment Viewer, and Community Features (BETA)!

Client Mod

  • Added: More heartbeat types (at flea, modding, or trading screen)
  • Added: Small adjustments to protection
  • Added: Now sends equipment info
  • Fixed: Re-uploading PMC image preview when playing as SCAV

Backend and SPTLB

  • Community Features (BETA) buttons along its functionality with SPTLB Network were added on each profile. You can now be friends!
  • Split friend list into local friends - the ones that are linked to your perma link or by team tag, and real ones - the ones you’ve added!
  • Equipment Viewer (BETA) - Now displays equipment on the preview model you have before you went into raid. Supports all guns, including the attachments, and ammo you have loaded in it!
  • Tidied up styles on all pages
  • Seasonal snow is now automatic and lasts until the end of this month
  • Fixed uppercase names on quests and hideout modules
  • Fixed local strings using explicit en-EN parameter - now it should be based off your system preferences
  • Fixed global insights not using present season data
  • Added more WTT weapon icons!
  • Fixed navbar not working properly on all pages
  • Now website streams your online status onto your profile if you’re logged in!
  • Fixed Live Data Flow paths using incorrect URL parameters, causing season data to not update
  • Removed lots of reduntant, outdated and unused pages, styles, and functions
  • Fixed score system running whenever player is in SCAV raid
  • Fixed weapon data never saving to weapon meta page
  • Fixed autologin using wrong session data
    • Upon logging in, you’ll be automatically remembered, even if session later on dies
    • Upon opening main leaderboard page you’ll be automatically logged in, if there’s no maintenance, or your account you logged in before is still valid/not banned
  • Fixed navbar styles not using all width of the container - now balance of more than 4 digits will not wrap with a newline
  • Small main leaderboard fix ups and CSS polish
  • Fixed showcase selector not working if you press ‘+’ icon and then choose the item
  • Added Christmas Illumination to the hideout modules
  • Garbage cleanup across all the infrastructure
  • Added two new BattlePass themes, along with small rewrite of the stylings (now it’s more dark)
  • Enlarged items inside inventory a little bit
  • Removed Global Chat
  • Removed Staff Online display
  • Removed public Rest API along its documentation
  • Moved some of the banned mods to bad mods
  • Fixed longest headshot stat showing ‘undefined’ if there’s none
  • Now items show if they can be sold, withdrawn, are quest items, or case items
  • Showcase no longer requires BattlePass Premium and no longer will show items that don’t exist in your inventory
  • Showcase is now synced with your leaderboard profile (no raid completion required)
  • Now restores scroll position and highlights previous opened player once its profile is closed (due how rendering of leaderboard is disabled during profile is open)
  • Fixed a rare case of leaderboard profiles soft locking you on loading if loading of customization fails
  • Map based background statuses with small animator rework in the background (whenever profile is open and in raid)

In this release

  • Removed redundant code

We’ve cleaned up lots of code across entire infrastructure, now including SPTLB Network overhaul!

Client Mod

  • Added: Handling for raid time exceed errors
  • Fixed: Casual mode equipment limit violation which was triggering even when Casual Mode was on - Thanks JUSTENERO!

API/Web

  • Cleaned up code from redundant data being saved to session, along with cases where after logging in it’d redirect you back to login page
  • Cleaned unused code from all JS modules

Inventory

  • Items no longer display in many grids when showing “All” - a better system is implemented
  • More sorting buttons were implemented
  • Showcase manager now shows all items when you wanna add an item

Profile Editing

Tarkov Market

  • Added following items:

Lend-Lease - Part 1

  • Health Resort east wing room 308 key
  • Health Resort east wing room 306 key

Vitamins - Part 1

  • EMERCOM medical unit key
  • Health Resort west wing office room 112 key

Against the Conscience - Part 1

  • Dorm overseer key

And other updates that were present in our Discord channel…

Drag and drop new version of the mod in your root SPT game folder. Make sure your token is backed up!

API/Web

Our latest (but not final!) Leaderboard 5.0.5 (SPT 4.0) Release.

We’ve improved a lot of stuff over the past few days, and now releasing our last, now only compatible version of SPT Leaderboard.

What’s changed?

  • Item Tracking - Now counts amount of items, this might impact the profit gain by a lot.
    • No longer tracks duplicates of items
    • No longer tracks PMC gear that was brought in raid
    • No longer tracks items twice if they were thrown and picked up back again
  • Fixed client mod not sending transition map to the API, resulting in status not showing
  • API was reworked to accordingly to the new datasets, including Prices API now being a module instead of an endpoint
  • A lot, and I mean a lot of CSS/JS work here and there across all the pages.
  • BattlePass adjustments were made to balance out both boosts and Premium users.
  • Potentially fixed custom names and Profile Pictures not applying on the leaderboard
  • Ranks are now applied properly, using total raids of the user. Added more ranks by name, and using 6 images of the rank per 10 levels now. Rank is based off your Network total raids! (Maximum is 2000)
  • Fixed raid time profile animator being declared earlier causing to break itself
  • More fixes to the themes
  • Cleaned up data being saved to the player that is no longer in use.

What now?

Enjoy the season, and most importantly, have a great time. We’ll still be around. Back after New Year. Built with passion. Powered by community 💜

In this release

  • Removed FixPluginTypesSerialization

Welcome back, to Season 7.

Top 3 players will receive the awards at their Network Profiles. Important: The mod version for SPT 3.11 LTS is being retired due to low player count (0.25% vs 99.75%) who uses that current version of the mod we support.

Release Notes

Client Mod

  • New: Now requires latest UnityToolkit mod. This will prevent any sudden lags or stutters upon the raid end on request, resulting in faster loading to the main menu.
  • New: Gained BattlePass EXP is now included for in-game raid end notification.
  • New: Now sends raid settings data (anonymous) for better calculations.
  • New: Now prevents sending duplicated raids on the client side to SPTLB API if any occur.
  • Fix: Raid profit calculation using wrong sets of TPLs to send to SPTLB API.
  • Fix: Duplicated requests for prices to SPTLB API.
  • Fix: Small JSON key adjustments to satisfy SPTLB API.

Website

  • Fixed season end screen not showing up due complexity of CF’s Rocket Loader along with other functions breaking after dataset update
  • Improved overall season end screen + added a new ending part
  • Fixed season end timer not being equal to everyone - this is now fixed and is using UNIX timestamp (UTC) instead of Date
  • Added new animated profile theme for those who have bought Premium BattlePass on SPTLB Network
  • Added Golden Plate username for Rank 1 who has won the previous season
  • Added new badge and username for those who have bought Premium BattlePass on SPTLB Network
  • Fixed achievement icon backgrounds - now they are used properly, instead of being blunt raw images with help of another service
  • Settings modal got a better look! Added Image Cache bypass option to prevent old images from caching, forcing the website to always try and get a fresh images
  • Settings now also properly work and save, and should no longer magically reset
  • Leaderboard table now hides itself once profile is opened for the sakes of optimization
  • Marked Skill Issue Detector as Beta™
  • Leaderboard BattlePass Level label on the profiles was renamed to “Leaderboard Level”
  • Minor CSS, JS, HTML and typo fix ups and browser compatibility

Network - Introducing our first BattlePass page!

BattlePass

  • Initial BattlePass Page was added to Network on Explore Page!
    • Explore the page, unlock more with Premium, collect/buy EXP boosts, and claim your rewards. All in one page. Check it out! -
    • Old SPT Leaderboard Battlepass is not affected by this by any means - all rewards in new BattlePass are exclusive!

Tarkov Market

  • Added a ton of new items to Tarkov Market! Including Hideout (by module LVL) bundles, clothing, weapons, and other items!
  • Some items now can have attributes, such as being unable to withdraw, or sell them.
  • Bundles Overhaul
    • Improved bundles - now they’ll breakdown every item they include and have a total LC saving included for better transparency
    • Displays how much you save LC if you buy the bundle instead of individually buying each item
  • Some of the drop chances were lowered for common drops

New personalization themes!

  • Now you can have two interactive themes - a Winter theme (you must have christmas illumination installed in hideout) and Premium theme!
  • Both themes come with custom personalization of player entry on leaderboard, and unique look of the profile

Overall Upgrades

  • API upgrade to v3.
    • Fixed numerous miscalculations, along with improved structure for the player weapons, reducing the size per player.
    • Added BattlePass EXP calculations for the client in responses.
    • Fixed other fields that are unused.
    • Added new fields for BattlePass to function on both Network and Website.
  • Upon withdrawing if the profile you’re on doesn’t match with the latest, the pop up prompt will appear for you to confirm you wanna withdraw items to a specific profile.
  • Skill Issue Detector™ Beta now uses more data to analyze.
  • All of the crucial functions are now behind the auth system.
  • Snowflakes were added to every page!
  • Fixed some instances where SPTLB Network would give you an error upon opening the page.
  • Restricted players will no longer have access to LC, Item Transfers and changing their profile appearance.
  • Improved Skill Score calculations, with higher ceiling for long-term players, giving more room to improve.
  • Fixed Security functions timing out user whenever credentials were right or not.
  • More notifications were added for some functions, instead of logging to the console.
  • General JS cleanup and improvements
  • Footer was added on every page with various statistics, such as online, in-game and other.
  • Allowed stash rows were increased for the client

Of course, it’s not all, there’s many other things I haven’t included in here, because it’s simply too many minor and not so changes across the project. It’s all up to you to find them!

Thanks List

  • 死Tarutarosu - For being active and helpful in the community
  • BONTON - For being active and helpful in the community
  • luciel - For being active and helpful in the community
  • Tarkov.dev - For providing a reliable and fast API
  • TARKYNATOR - For providing a reliable and constructive breakdown of in-game items, images and overall Tarkov database
  • And everyone in our Discord Server or the Project - Thank you for playing!

Here again with SPTLB Network Overhaul and Stattrack Support!

Client Mod

  • QoL: If banned mods are detected, the mod will send in-game notification with the list of them.
  • Mod disables itself if headless client is detected. Thanks to Fika Project for adding it to their list as well!
  • Returned Stattrack by AcidPhantasm mod support - mod will record your weapon statistics per usual.
  • Now gets price tables off our Server for profit calculation. The price table is tied to PvE prices and updates every 24 hours automatically. Including handbook prices thanks to SPT!
  • No longer sends profit as SCAV if player died in raid.
  • No longer counts entire pouches or other containers in profit. Only counts items being put/thrown away. Please note that the profit does not include item durability. It’s all clean prices.

SPTLB Network - Main Changes

  • New case! - “U2FsdGVkX19jSCH/KC43WFaq8R1PNd3j1fttim8IWviWAe2VIIxRQvlw9ftQKQyV07hZwy7NTNnE”
  • Now you get daily cases! Daily SPTLB Case will be added to your inventory once every 24 hours you login on the website.
  • Added more quest items to Tarkov Market, resulting in more than 200 items being available.
  • New feature: LC Transfers
    • Transfer your LC across your friends, or just share with someone you like. Have it your way.
    • LC Cannot be transferred across banned, yourself, or Casual Players.
    • Any LC transfers can only be done once per hour.
  • New feature: Item Transfers
    • Now you can send items across Network Profiles too!
    • Item transfers have a small cooldown
    • Players will not able to send cases - otherwise you’re good to go :)
  • New feature: Dynamic, pseudo-random and progressive sales
    • Instead of just rapidly raising the price, random items would have a discount each 3 days - this would affect items that weren’t bought at all, or bought with a small amount, randomly and based off their rarity. Discount would grow up to 35% of the base price, then reset once the item is bought.
  • New feature: Daily Case
    • There would be a special case that you can’t buy from Tarkov Market but only obtain by logging in daily, said case would be claimed automatically every login if available and appear in your inventory!
  • Boosted drop chances of some legendary items

Including small fixes and additions

  • Hidden items that were opened from cases won’t be affected by discounts and its price.
  • Session saving wasn’t working correctly.
  • New distinguishable case icons were added to the inventory and Tarkov Market!
  • Players can no longer buy hidden items.
  • Set initial balance of players to 0 LC upon registering.
  • Fixed bad CSS labels on Edit Profile page.

Tarkov Market new Item List

  • Labrys access keycard. Keep in mind, this is for SPT 4.0 players! Any other SPT players trying to withdraw that item, won’t get anything and lose it forever.
  • Added Graphics Card
  • Added Printed circuit board
  • Added Power supply unit
  • Added Cordura polyamide fabric
  • Added Aramid fiber fabric
  • Added T-7 Thermal Goggles - won’t be hidden
  • Added 5.56x45mm M855 ammo pack (50 pcs)

  • Added M67 hand grenade

  • Added Lower half-mask
  • Added AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine
  • Added Mystery Ranch SATL Bridger Assault Pack (Foliage)
  • Added RB-BK marked key
  • Added Dorm room 314 marked key
  • Added S I C C organizational pouch
  • Added Weapon case
  • Added Item case

Installation

Backup your secret token and reinstall the mod fresh, then put your secret.token file back inside at BepInEx/plugins/SPT-Leaderboard/<DROP HERE>

5.0.1 (re-release - UPGRADE REQUIRED)

Kira Speaking - Quick hotfix we (I) forgot to merge some changes in, and it was missing some of the changes, this includes the actual working changes, that is my fault.

Client

  • Fixed Raid Profit calculations for PMC’s to be more accurate
  • Fixed Scav Raids not being loot-tracked & Fixed Raid Profit calculations for Scav Raids to be more accurate
  • Fixed client mod not recognizing Labyrinth map and returning UNKNOWN to the server

Website & SPTLB Network

  • Fixed commenting on player profiles
  • Added more item listings to the Tarkov Market
  • Gave Friend List more max-height to show more friends if there’s more than 4
  • Added new “Partial Restricted” status:
    • This is for players with improper names whose names will start with P_
    • Players in this state are unable to change their Icon, and Name forever.
    • We no longer ban for inappropriate names, instead force name a player.
  • Added 100 Achievements for a total of 163 in total, this can be found in the Network Login => Rewards tab.
    • That makes a total of 111 In-Game Achievements with Skills Extended installed and 163 Achievements on website.
  • And other cumulative fixes across web pages…

New Season, New Features, New Me.

We’ve come to announce that Season 6 has started! We will be keeping an eye on SPT ~3.11 as an LTS feature-locked branch while we progress with SPT 4.0. Both versions of the mod (4.1.2 and 5.0.0) are supported!

Client

  • Updated to SPT 4.0.
  • Now sends hydration, energy values.
  • Now sends profit/loss of the raid in RUB for both SCAV and PMC. Your items you brought in raid will not count. Profit is determined by the loot you picked up with limitations of not showing profit loss when you die without looting everything (profit gain will be 0 RUB)
  • Now sends a list of completed Quests, their accept time and quest finish time (the time the reward was accepted).
  • Now sends hideout data
  • Now sends damage taken in raid
  • Tracks average headshot distance
  • After a small discussion, we have decided to drop support for Private Profiles - you’ll no longer see this option in the configuration on 5.0.0 or 4.1.2.
  • Refactored profile class

Server

  • Initial update to SPT 4.0.
  • Now includes configuration for the endpoint to where to send a request for the incoming mails.
  • Now handles prices of the items using handbook for client mod to request.

Backend

  • Rewritten main endpoint to handle requests for both 3.11 and 4.0 users.
  • Removed deprecated data along with support for Private Profiles.
  • Fixed counters for PMC/SCAV raid times along global ones being set incorrectly.
  • Fixed new season not applying to the market account and being read incorrectly.
  • Supporting hideout, damage taken, current hydration and hunger values, along with completed quests.
  • Increased player history of the raids to 1000 raids.
  • Now handles public data differently (by permaLink) instead of tying to a profile ID.

Website

  • Updated compiled achievement list to match 4.0.0 SPT IDs. Now website will combine both 3.11 and 4.0.0 achievement tables for backward compatibility.
  • Added missing images of new achievements.
  • Added snowy theme on all main pages along with small snowflakes.
  • Arranged JS file system properly with descriptive names.
  • Page names and paths were updated (i.e /weapon-meta/ to /meta/ or /api-documentation/ to /api-docs/).
  • Fixed global achievements page showing “Full Stats” in tab name.
  • Fixed leaderboard table not scaling its width on bigger screens.
  • Improved season end screen with video overlays and moved its functionality in separate file.
  • Updated footer links and added additional text along with fixing a few typos.
  • Leaderboard Battlepass progress bar will light up with gold (yellow) color when max level is reached.
  • Your session is saved across main page and SPTLB Network.
  • Small indicator will be shown on the main leaderboard page, if you’re already logged in, or have to enter your credentials again if you decide to log in.
  • You can no longer send comments (or, try to) if you’re not logged in or not authenticated in SPTLB Network to prevent visual confusion.
  • Success/fail indications were added when sending a comment on user profile.
  • Leaderboard no longer goes through every season every time the app starts up to determine an amount of seasons profile has played.
  • Comment section now have more CSS friendly to the profile themes.
  • Increased Live Data Flow update interval to 10 seconds.
  • Code cleanup. Moved most of the helper functions to utils.js
  • Removed repeated initProfileWatchList() function in season data load.
  • Cross-play between 3.11 and 4.0 players support was added.
  • Versions of SPT 3.11 will light up in blue color on the leaderboard table, indicating an LTS.
  • Added max and current hydration, health (its max value) and hunger values below player image preview.
  • Raid profit will be shown for each raid in RUB in user raid history - how much pure money you’ve brought out, or lost (including your gear)
  • Many JS improvements - moving out nested functions, removing duplicate code along with fixing achievement processing.
  • Fixed leaderboard battlepass level showing “NaN” when there’s no PMC stats recorded.
  • Reworked Welcome Page. Less heavy and laggy, shows stats inherited from global counters, and brief showcase of features, including less scrolling for a user.
  • Fixed issues with CF Rocket Loader which made opening profiles on page reload no longer work.

SPTLB Network

  • Added search which works for names, descriptions, quests, categories and bundle compositions of the item.
  • Fixed CSS for category tabs to not look like white boxes.
  • Added 2 new cases - “Terragroup Secrets Case” and “Military Tech Case”, contents will be shown down below.
  • 26 new items on the tarkov market.
  • Fixed toolset item not being a toolset.
  • Small price adjustment - for some official cases and items.
  • Reduced common knives drop rate in Tarkov Knife Case.
  • Added Gear category - high-end armor, Altyn (faceshield included) and Rys-T (faceshield included) are available to be purchased as a bundle.
  • Added quest item Ushanka to Gear category.
  • Added Advanced current converter to the Military Tech Case.
  • Added quest key Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key.
  • With that, ammo packs were added - 5.45x39mm BS gs, 5.45x39mm BS gs, 5.45x39mm BT gs, 4.6x30mm AP SX, 5.56x45mm SSA AP.
  • All items will be shuffled with page open for variety.
  • Tarkov Market will now show most Popular Items on top of the search, its current price and amount of times it’s been bought.

4.1.3 LTS Release - SPT 3.11 ONLY

  • Migrated all the newest changes from latest release to SPT 3.11 mod version.

What’s changed

Server

Website & SPTLB Network

  • Boost values were nullified, and new values will be applied once you finish a raid, including:

SPT Leaderboard 4.1.0 Release Migration to https://sptlb.yuyui.moe/ was completed, and Season 5 continues! GitHub website will automatically redirect you to the new page

Installation: Drag and drop the latest release in your root SPT installation.

Do not re-install the mod fresh (delete + place new files). If you have old installations, just drag and drop the files and confirm merge. Keep your token backed up at all costs!

What’s changed [Server]

  • Fixed vulnerable paths to endpoints being exposed
  • More strict API access
  • Fixed validation preventing various XSS attacks

Client

  • Accustom to the new server changes
  • Send XY coordinates of last death
  • Send average distance of a shot in a raid

Website

  • Accustom to the server and SPTLB Network links
  • Fixed various issues with Online and profile loading

And other small bugfixes accross the system…

Virus Total

https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/b83b5d973c2c20ede6637ce5deb13062a2b308a527924e6874c4e8a773507fd3

Season 4 Ends, and we are awaiting for you to join us in a new journey.

We recommend to read through this update, because it’s just too big to put in two words.

What you NEED to know before you install this update:
- Your token will be automatically migrated to BepInEx/plugins/SPT-Leaderboard/ once you update. It is recommended to delete SPT Leaderboard mod, and reinstall the mod fully.
- With huge help of Katrin and as a part of SPT Leaderboard Project, project is now split into two mods - Server and Client side. Server side responds for external inbox check while client mod - for everything else.
- Read through LA/TOS. It’s been updated, and make sure you agree to those terms before proceeding to install this mod.

Update Notes: Client mod
- Ported main part of the mod from TS to C#.
- Added dynamic PMC icon/full height submission to the leaderboard website. Now you can flex. (Thanks to jbobyh!)
- Mod will show error notifications with localization.
- Mod will check for mods & version of the mod before raid will be started.
- Fixed checking for developer items.
- Mod will check capacity of Secured Container/Backpack/Tactical Vests/Pockets/Stash.
- Mod will send new statuses to Leaderboard Website - In Hideout, In Transit
- Mod will check for Kappa Container (fixed).
- Now properly sending “In Raid” heartbeats.
- Mod will count and send the number of hits to different parts of the enemy’s body.
- Mod will send aggressor name to Website.
- Mod will send Boss & SCAV kills to Website.
- Mod will retry submitting data if timeout was thrown.

Update Notes: Back-End
- Upgraded API to v2. Better data handling, new request protection and overall stability.
- Accustomed to new Client Mod changes and data set.
- Reworked heartbeat system on API - names, and its entries should not disappear. Now sending data of map, in-game time, and Side player’s on.
- Now calculates hits and stores up to 3 raids for Website.
- Register players inside its Network for Tarkov Market upon success in the SPT Leaderboard Network and calculates website currency for raid earned.
- Ban system changes: With newest changes, this system will lean towards automatic moderation more than ever. API will filter requests and not let potentially bad requests further than just accepting it.

Update Notes: Website
- Full rewrite of player profile system. New Full Screen profile, supporting all of the features with massive overhaul of existing features.
- Added Hit History by body parts on the profile
- Overhauled Raid History:
Now will show by who player has died, and properly showing colored borders for raids where player left, or ran through.
Raid history will be fragmented into files and connected to player id through seasons (no longer 200k lines of one file for everyone).
Raid history will have a cap of 250 raids, old raids will be deleted one by one once cap has been reached with each raid.
Error rate has been minimized.
Load times into profile will be less.
Empty raids where player did not gain anything won’t show useless statistics anymore - just a small card instead will be shown.

- Enhanced notifications:
Will no longer spam with sounds upon page opening/refresh
Maximum 5 notifications will be shown
Will only show notifications for raids which happened less than 5 minutes ago
Will have a ~2 second delay before showing

Update Notes: Other
- Overhauled Achievements - Now showing all of them along recent one, including % of global achieve rate of each achievement.
- Dynamic PFPs - Now if you don’t have a profile picture set, it will default to your PMCs face from game.
- Dynamic Player Post-Raid overview. Your entire player model will be shown on your profile with your gear on after you’ve started a raid.
- Various overhauls of the main page, styles and JS code:
Improved Leaderboard, now it shows all players (and total) raids played.
Returned color indicators for player statistics.
Drastically improved loading times by using local season files and less data on update, instead of requesting them from server.
Various fixes for different display aspect ratios on the leaderboard - Katrin

- New Feature - Skill boost:
Now your installed mods would matter - every single player who registered on the leaderboard would have a “skill boost” by %, depending on your mods installed.
Mods will be split in three categories - Banned, Good and Bad.
Banned mods would act the same, not letting you to rank up.
Now it directly affects skill score with its value.
Every player will have it displayed, no matter state of the profile (Private/Public) except players marked as suspicious (it will still be applied), or banned.

Welcome to SPTLB Network - Now with its own Tarkov Market, where you can buy items for earning points by playing or using leaderboard!

- Profile Editor is now a part SPTLB Network

- Explore Page was added:
Treat it as a landing page, it will show 4 buttons of where you can go - Tarkov Market, Your Inventory, Edit Profile, or Report a Player
Shows recent purchases of players from Tarkov Market

Tarkov Market
- Buy Quest item keys or items. Designed for people who play with no flea or just hardcore fellas but still want fair progression!
- Earn Leaderboard Coins by playing and finishing the game - every raid your balance will be tied to your profile ID. Boss, SCAV, PMC and time you spent in the raid - everything counts towards your balance.
- Buy items, receive them in your SPTLB Network inventory. Now website provides you with inventory where you can keep them forever, or withdraw into your game, by one item, or whole inventory!
- Your inventory also shows base price and entire price of your inventory. Hover over bought items to see how much they cost, what quests they are needed for, or their current price.
- Your inventory will be used to receive various rewards from developers, or upcoming features.
- Every time an item is bought, it increases in price until next restock (48 hours) by roughly ~10%

Report players
- Report a player and Leaderboard Team will review it as soon as possible, rewarding you for your report if it was determined the report was useful.
- You can report a player only once
